title: Hemodynamic comfort intervention-logic proposal (HYPOTHESIS ONLY)
claim_class: Every item below is a structural/directional HYPOTHESIS read off the proven arterial-pressure loop (RP4 reject / T1 durable / T2 margin). None is a treatment, a molecule, a dose, an efficacy result, a safety result, or a tolerability result. All clinical magnitudes are [O] OPEN and require laboratory and clinical validation the author does not perform. No medical responsibility.

proposals.statement: Intervene at the loop SETPOINT -- the renal pressure-natriuresis / RAAS reference -- rather than at the operating point.
proposals.basis: The package proved the loop is an integral controller that rejects operating-point pushes back toward its reference (RP4 opposed_back; T1 operating-point drop is not durable). The setpoint is the variable a durable, counter-regulation-free direction must move.

proposals.statement: Move the reference DOWN toward the normotensive attractor; do not crush perfusion below the floor, because the symmetric failure is the hypotension node decomposition.
proposals.basis: Lowering the defended pressure is the aim; overshoot is bounded by the perfusion floor and the orthostatic/distributive failures the package already decomposes (RP6-RP9, CAL7 floor). The target is a controlled return toward normotension, not a fall through the floor.

proposals.statement: Rank target axes by counter-regulation-freedom combined with DNA/biology grounding: reference-reset axes first (renal-sympathetic; RAAS/REN, DNA-grounded; Na/volume, SIX2-grounded), then buffer restoration (baroreflex/PIEZO), with effector unload as a PAIRED adjunct only.
proposals.basis: Counter-regulation-freedom is read off the proven loop (H1 free, H2 low, H3 prone-alone); DNA grounding is the measured master-gene gamma (REN=1.3634, SIX2=1.5556). Selectivity/burden are cited Layer-2 biology. The map supplies the reproducible ordering.
proposals.grade: [F] ranking from proven loop + cited axis biology

proposals.statement: Prefer a mechanism that lowers the reference WITHOUT being sensed as an acute disturbance, so the integral controller does not register an error and does not oppose it -- the structural shape that is counter-regulation-free.
proposals.basis: This is the structural shape that distinguishes a durable reference reset (T1) from an opposed operating-point push (RP4). It is named here as a design SHAPE, not a molecule.
proposals.grade: [F] structural mechanism shape; any molecule realising it is [O]

proposals.statement: Because the targeted variable is the loop's OWN setpoint, this direction is pursued as a durable, counter-regulation-free antihypertensive logic that structurally does not provoke the reflex push-back driving the familiar side-effect class; whether any given molecule achieves durable control, tolerability, or an improved profile is an open empirical question, not a claim made here.
proposals.basis: Structural rationale only, from the proven RP4/T1 directions. The empirical outcome for any candidate is [O] and must be established by proper preclinical and clinical work.

proposals.statement: For chronic heart failure, grow the basin margin M = spinodal(kappa) - |load| by reducing load and breaking the maladaptive neurohormonal cycle (the four-pillar direction), never by flogging the effector, which shrinks the margin.
proposals.basis: The package proved the high-output fixed point exists iff spinodal(kappa) > |load| and that inotrope-flog shrinks the margin while load-reduce + cycle-break grows it (RP5, T2). The SGLT2i arm links to the macula-densa NaCl sensor.
proposals.grade: [F] structural direction (from proven RP5/T2); mortality magnitude [O]

proposals.statement: If an effector unload (vasodilator / volume reduction) is used, pair it ONLY in concert with a reference reset (H1) so the unload is not opposed; never as operating-point monotherapy.
proposals.basis: Effector unload alone is rejected back (RP4) -- the rejection is the side-effect class; paired with a reference reset the loop's target has moved, so the unload is no longer opposed (the diuretic/renal backbone of durable regimens). This is the integrator caveat the nociceptor gate does not have.
proposals.grade: [F] structural pairing rule (from proven RP4 + integrator contrast)

explicit_non_claims: No molecule is designed or named as a proposed drug.
No synthesis, formulation, or manufacturing route is provided.
No dose, regimen, or route of administration is provided.
No efficacy, potency, safety, tolerability, or pharmacokinetic result is asserted.
'Counter-regulation-free' is a structural property of the loop direction, not a clinical tolerability or safety result.
Nothing here diagnoses, treats, cures, or prevents any condition, and no patient should act on it.
